paragraphs: Rav Tavi bar Kisna is mentioned in [Eruvin 104b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.104b.10). [Yevamot 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.40b.27) reads “Rav Tuvi.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=203) has Rav Tavi (רב טבי). The supplied Hebrew transcription has קב מבי.
Eruvin gives Tavi and Yevamot gives Tuvi, both speaking in the name of Shmuel.
Bava Batra separately names Rava bar Kisna in a discussion of vineyard measurements, as cited by [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3105&lang=en).
